Dixon Residential are delighted to present this beautifully maintained 3-bedroom residence, ideally positioned in the heart of Glasnevin - a highly sought-after and well-established residential location.

Presented in excellent condition throughout, this home offers a fantastic opportunity for first-time buyers, downsizers, or investors seeking a property with nothing to do but move in. The accommodation is bright and well-proportioned, featuring a welcoming entrance hall, spacious living room, and a modern kitchen/dining area. Upstairs comprises three generous bedrooms and a family bathroom. In addition, the attic offers excellent potential for conversion.

To the rear, a low-maintenance garden provides the perfect outdoor space for relaxing or entertaining, complete with a steel shed offering additional storage.

The property enjoys a prime Glasnevin location, within easy reach of a host of local amenities including schools, shops, parks, and excellent public transport links. Dublin City Centre, DCU, and the M50 are also easily accessible.

Viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate all this wonderful home has to offer.
